description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapCanvas' which renders an interactive mind map diagram using SVG. It includes layout logic for node placement, connections, zooming, panning, and node styling based on their types and roles within a career transition pathway. The code also contains utility functions for layout computation and node categorization, as well as visual styling and interaction handling.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown input to a trimmed string, handling nullish values.

methods.name: numberOrNull
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a finite number or null if invalid.

methods.name: extractPercentRange
methods.description: Attempts to extract a percentage range from a node's data fields.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a node likely represents a step or milestone.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Computes node levels for layout based on edges and a central node.

methods.name: nodeLane
methods.description: Assigns a layout lane to a node based on its type and role.

methods.name: buildAdjacency
methods.description: Builds adjacency maps for nodes from edge data.

methods.name: chooseRightPrimary
methods.description: Selects the right primary node based on levels and connection data.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Computes explicit node positions and connections for the mind map layout.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a label string into multiple lines fitting max character and line constraints.

methods.name: MindmapCanvas
methods.description: React component rendering an interactive, zoomable, pannable SVG mind map diagram that visualizes career pathways with nodes, edges, and layout logic.
